lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਝੁ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਕਿਝੁ ਨ ਸੁਝੈ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਗੁਝੀ ਭਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kijh na bujhai kijh na sujhai duneeaa gujhee bhaahi ||
lines.translation: I know nothing; I understand nothing. The world is a smouldering fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਈਂ ਮੇਰੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ ਹੰ ਭੀ ਦਝਾਂ ਆਹਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)ee(n) merai cha(n)gaa keetaa naahee ta ha(n) bhee dajhaa(n) aahi ||3||
lines.translation: My Lord did well to warn me about it; otherwise, I would have been burnt as well. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਤਿਲ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਸੰਮਲਿ ਬੁਕੁ ਭਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa je jaanaa til thoRaRe sa(n)mal buk bharee ||
lines.translation: Fareed, if I had known that I had so few sesame seeds, I would have been more careful with them in my hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਸਹੁ ਨੰਢੜਾ ਤਾਂ ਥੋੜਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਕਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: je jaanaa sahu na(n)dhaRaa taa(n) thoRaa maan karee ||4||
lines.translation: If I had known that my Husband Lord was so young and innocent, I would not have been so arrogant. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਲੜੁ ਛਿਜਣਾ ਪੀਡੀ ਪਾਈਂ ਗੰਢਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: je jaanaa laR chhijanaa peedee paaee(n) ga(n)dh ||
lines.translation: If I had known that my robe would come loose, I would have tied a tighter knot.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੈ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਡਿਠਾ ਹੰਢਿ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: tai jevad mai naahi ko sabh jag dithaa ha(n)dh ||5||
lines.translation: I have found none as great as You, Lord; I have looked and searched throughout the world. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਅਕਲਿ ਲਤੀਫੁ ਕਾਲੇ ਲਿਖੁ ਨ ਲੇਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa je too akal lateeph kaale likh na lekh ||
lines.translation: Fareed, if you have a keen understanding, then do not write black marks against anyone else.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੇ ਗਿਰੀਵਾਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਂੀਵਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੁ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaRe gireevaan mahi sir na(n)eevaa(n) kar dekh ||6||
lines.translation: Look underneath your own collar instead. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੋ ਤੈ ਮਾਰਨਿ ਮੁਕੀਆਂ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਨ ਮਾਰੇ ਘੁੰਮਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa jo tai maaran mukeeaa(n) tinhaa na maare ghu(n)m ||
lines.translation: Fareed, do not turn around and strike those who strike you with their fists.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਪੈਰ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦੇ ਚੁੰਮਿ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaRai ghar jaaeeai pair tinhaa de chu(n)m ||7||
lines.translation: Kiss their feet, and return to your own home. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਾਂ ਤਉ ਖਟਣ ਵੇਲ ਤਾਂ ਤੂ ਰਤਾ ਦੁਨੀ ਸਿਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa jaa(n) tau khatan vel taa(n) too rataa dunee siu ||
lines.translation: Fareed, when there was time for you to earn good karma, you were in love with the world instead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਗ ਸਵਾਈ ਨੀਹਿ ਜਾਂ ਭਰਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਲਦਿਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: marag savaaee neehi jaa(n) bhariaa taa(n) ladiaa ||8||
lines.translation: Now, death has a strong foothold; when the load is full, it is taken away. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੁ ਥੀਆ ਦਾੜੀ ਹੋਈ ਭੂਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekh phareedaa j theeaa daaRee hoee bhoor ||
lines.translation: See, Fareed, what has happened: your beard has become grey.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਹੁ ਨੇੜਾ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਛਾ ਰਹਿਆ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: agahu neRaa aaiaa pichhaa rahiaa door ||9||
lines.translation: That which is coming is near, and the past is left far behind. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖੁ ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿ ਥੀਆ ਸਕਰ ਹੋਈ ਵਿਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dekh phareedaa j theeaa sakar hoee vis ||
lines.translation: See, Fareed, what has happened: sugar has become poison.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਆਪਣੇ ਵੇਦਣ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)ee baajhahu aapane vedan kaheeai kis ||10||
lines.translation: Without my Lord, who can I tell of my sorrow? ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਪਤੀਣੀਆਂ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਰੀਣੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa akhee dekh pateeneeaa(n) sun sun reene ka(n)n ||
lines.translation: Fareed, my eyes have become weak, and my ears have become hard of hearing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਖ ਪਕੰਦੀ ਆਈਆ ਹੋਰ ਕਰੇਂਦੀ ਵੰਨ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: saakh paka(n)dee aaeeaa hor kare(n)dee va(n)n ||11||
lines.translation: The body's crop has become ripe and turned color. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਾਲਂੀ ਜਿਨੀ ਨ ਰਾਵਿਆ ਧਉਲੀ ਰਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kaala(n)ee jinee na raaviaa dhaulee raavai koi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, those who did not enjoy their Spouse when their hair was black - hardly any of them enjoy Him when their hair turns grey.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਂਈ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਰੰਗੁ ਨਵੇਲਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: kar saa(n)ee siu pirahaRee ra(n)g navelaa hoi ||12||
lines.translation: So be in love with the Lord, so that your color may ever be new. ||12||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕਾਲੀ ਧਉਲੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kaalee dhaulee saahib sadaa hai je ko chit kare ||
lines.translation: Fareed, whether one's hair is black or grey, our Lord and Master is always here if one remembers Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa laaiaa piram na lagaee je lochai sabh koi ||
lines.translation: This loving devotion to the Lord does not come by one's own efforts, even though all may long for it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਪਿਰਮੁ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੈ ਦੇਇ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: ehu piram piaalaa khasam kaa jai bhaavai tai dei ||13||
lines.translation: This cup of loving devotion belongs to our Lord and Master; He gives it to whomever He likes. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਲੋਇਣ ਜਗੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਸੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਮੈ ਡਿਠੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa jinh loin jag mohiaa se loin mai dith ||
lines.translation: Fareed, those eyes which have enticed the world - I have seen those eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਜਲ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਸਹਦਿਆ ਸੇ ਪੰਖੀ ਸੂਇ ਬਹਿਠੁ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: kajal rekh na sahadiaa se pa(n)khee sooi bahith ||14||
lines.translation: Once, they could not endure even a bit of mascara; now, the birds hatch their young in them! ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਕੂਕੇਦਿਆ ਚਾਂਗੇਦਿਆ ਮਤੀ ਦੇਦਿਆ ਨਿਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa kookediaa chaa(n)gediaa matee dediaa nit ||
lines.translation: Fareed, they shouted and yelled, and constantly gave good advice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸੈਤਾਨਿ ਵੰਞਾਇਆ ਸੇ ਕਿਤ ਫੇਰਹਿ ਚਿਤ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: jo saitaan va(n)njaaiaa se kit pherahi chit ||15||
lines.translation: But those whom the devil has spoiled - how can they turn their consciousness towards God? ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਥੀਉ ਪਵਾਹੀ ਦਭੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa theeu pavaahee dabh ||
lines.translation: Fareed, become the grass on the path,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਸਾਂਈ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸਭੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: je saa(n)ee loRahi sabh ||
lines.translation: if you long for the Lord of all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਛਿਜਹਿ ਬਿਆ ਲਤਾੜੀਅਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik chhijahi biaa lataaReeahi ||
lines.translation: One will cut you down, and another will trample you underfoot;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਂ ਸਾਈ ਦੈ ਦਰਿ ਵਾੜੀਅਹਿ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: taa(n) saaee dai dar vaaReeahi ||16||
lines.translation: then, you shall enter the Court of the Lord. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਖਾਕੁ ਨ ਨਿੰਦੀਐ ਖਾਕੂ ਜੇਡੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa khaak na ni(n)deeai khaakoo jed na koi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, do not slander the dust; noting is as great as dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਪੈਰਾ ਤਲੈ ਮੁਇਆ ਉਪਰਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: jeevadiaa pairaa talai muiaa upar hoi ||17||
lines.translation: When we are alive, it is under our feet, and when we are dead, it is above us. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜਾ ਲਬੁ ਤਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਲਬੁ ਤ ਕੂੜਾ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa jaa lab taa nehu kiaa lab ta kooRaa nehu ||
lines.translation: Fareed, when there is greed, what love can there be? When there is greed, love is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਚਰੁ ਝਤਿ ਲਘਾਈਐ ਛਪਰਿ ਤੁਟੈ ਮੇਹੁ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: kichar jhat laghaaeeai chhapar tutai mehu ||18||
lines.translation: How long can one remain in a thatched hut which leaks when it rains? ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਭਵਹਿ ਵਣਿ ਕੰਡਾ ਮੋੜੇਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa ja(n)gal ja(n)gal kiaa bhavahi van ka(n)daa moRehi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, why do you wander from jungle to jungle, crashing through the thorny trees?

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਸੀ ਰਬੁ ਹਿਆਲੀਐ ਜੰਗਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੇਹਿ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: vasee rab hiaaleeai ja(n)gal kiaa dhoodhehi ||19||
lines.translation: The Lord abides in the heart; why are you looking for Him in the jungle? ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਇਨੀ ਨਿਕੀ ਜੰਘੀਐ ਥਲ ਡੂੰਗਰ ਭਵਿਓਮੑਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa inee nikee ja(n)gheeai thal doo(n)gar bhaviomhi ||
lines.translation: Fareed, with these small legs, I crossed deserts and mountains.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਜੁ ਫਰੀਦੈ ਕੂਜੜਾ ਸੈ ਕੋਹਾਂ ਥੀਓਮਿ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: aj phareedai koojaRaa sai kohaa(n) theeom ||20||
lines.translation: But today, Fareed, my water jug seems hundreds of miles away. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਰੀਦਾ ਰਾਤੀ ਵਡੀਆਂ ਧੁਖਿ ਧੁਖਿ ਉਠਨਿ ਪਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: phareedaa raatee vadeeaa(n) dhukh dhukh uthan paas ||
lines.translation: Fareed, the nights are long, and my sides are aching in pain.
